note: Derived from the observation vocabulary the hosted service actually emits, read from retained run records rather than from documentation. Two streams arrive together and are treated differently on purpose: scenario execution corresponds to circuit topology and lights it; delivery phases are the service's own stages and are shown as telemetry beside the circuit, because the circuit is not a picture of the delivery pipeline.

scenarioSteps.meaning: The capability's input was admitted against its contract.
The authority for the scenario's event was resolved. In an operations view this is the port; where a capability declares none, the event node is the nearest thing the instrumentation establishes.
The resolved authority executed. For a provider-backed capability this is the provider node; the observation does not establish which internal mechanic ran.
A returned outcome was admitted against its contract.
The domain disposition was resolved. Provider success and business success remain separate facts.

deliveryPhases.label: Read authority
deliveryPhases.meaning: Selected estate authority was read from the database.

deliveryPhases.label: Plan native body
deliveryPhases.meaning: The executable plan was assembled from the selected authority.

deliveryPhases.label: Load modules
deliveryPhases.meaning: The planned modules were loaded for execution.

deliveryPhases.label: Execute scenario
deliveryPhases.meaning: The scenario ran. Its internal steps arrive as scenario observations.

unplacedPolicy.note: An observation with no mapped node keeps its identities and is listed with them. Dropping it would make the circuit look more complete than the evidence is.
